findings.evidence: The routing table has overlapping rows with no precedence rule. Recurring behavior across several people (the team-wide-recurring eval) matches both "Recurring behavior -> R2" and "Same issue across several people -> R3", and recurring upward feedback matches both R2 and R4
findings.fix: Add one line above the table: "If several rows match, apply R6 first, then R1, R3 or R4, and treat R2 as a modifier (pick one or two instances) on whichever row applies."
